summary: All 104 saved responses matched their recorded SHA-256 and size, and all four reported computations reproduced. The author DESeq2 download returned HTTP 403, supporting access_blocked_documented. The corrected proposal records that all eight samples from the related GSE318040 study were white adipose tissue. It also clarifies that the registered PVN table contains P values and FDR for 18,314 symbols. Agreement with the authors’ results remains untested.
openIssues: The author table is needed to verify gene identifiers, coefficient direction, filtering, coverage and statistical agreement. GEO lists July 1, 2027 as the scheduled release date. [GEO access notice](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE317867&targ=all&form=text&view=full)
